(Ugh!)

Hm?

Huh?
What?!
Hurry!
A-aye!

Just watch.
We've got them!

Keep them coming!

Heave!

coming down on us!
Watch out! Ｉt might be poison!

All ships, charge! Boarders on deck!
Get ready! Sail crew, raise the sails!

Th-the deck's slippery!

sails up!

Ｉ can't! Every time the ship rocks, my
feet slip... Whoa!

What are you doing?! Damn it, give me
that! Whoa, whoa!
Captain, it's no use!

Th-this can't be happening! Hrrgh!
Aaah!
C-Captain!
Guh...!
The captain hit his head!

Now's our chance! All hands, prepare
to board!

What's going on? They
can barely stand!

Now's our chance! Ryoke, get
ready to board!

Look there! That's FO, the
fleet that's been trespassing
in our waters!
Yeah!

All hands, battle stations!
Snake, take command!
Aye!

Angel! Take us around to their
starboard quarter!
Aye aye, Captain! Leave it to me!
Dandy! Are the guns ready?
All in readiness, Captain.

Heh heh. Ｉ'm getting chills. Now listen
up, you lot!

Let's settle who deserves to rule these
seas, me or FO!
Yeah!
A woman pirate?!

She looks like trouble. Be careful with
this one.

Ｆound you at last! This time
we settle it!
Yeah!

Back for more, FO? You
never learn. This time Ｉ'll send you to
the bottom!

Damn it! How could a slip of a girl
take the jar from me?
Juan...

Grrr! Look at the state of
you! Damn it!

Ho ho ho! You fools never knew how
badly you were outmatched!
Damn it! How did Ｉ lose? Rotten luck!
Vels!
G-Gerhard...!

You let greed blind you and went back
to piracy, you fool!

Another damn lecture? Ｉ've had
enough! Spare me!
A lecture, is it?!

That's right! 'Discipline and thrift.'
Where's the fun in a life like that?
That's exactly why Ｉ call you a fool!
What?!

You may not know it, but you're
already a better sailor than Ｉ am.

Then how could Ｉ possibly
lose to you?!

That's how blind you are. Greed's
eaten away at you and dulled your
skill. You can't even see it!
You're calling me corrupt?!

Ｉ told you when we met. True strength
comes from character, before
skill or muscle.

Discipline and thrift were meant to
build your character. Why can't you
see that?

That's what Ｉ can't stand! You're a
lion, all right. An old lion whose time
has passed!

Ｉ take what Ｉ want by force and knock
down anyone in my way. Long as Ｉ
enjoy myself, that's enough for me!

Ｉ was the fool for trying to teach you.
You're no pupil of mine. Get out of
my sight!

Ｉ never counted myself your pupil! Ｉt
won't go this way next time!
Damn it...
Damn it!

Ah! Y-you! Ｉ remember you
now, you bastard!

Ｉ'd know that petty crook's face
anywhere. You pinned that
theft on me!
Wait... You're the one from back then!

Heh heh. Admiral, mind if Ｉ handle
this one?

On second thought, nobody's talking
me out of this. Now get ready, you!

W-wait. Ｉ had no choice back then.
Just hear me out...
Oof!
W-wait...

That's enough. Hitting him again
won't do you any good.

Ｆor the admiral's sake, Ｉ'll let you go.
Use my name again and you'll get a
lot worse than this!
Aaah!

Julian, what did you throw
onto their ship?

Ｉ crushed up some soap and dissolved
it in water.
S-soapy water?!
Soapy water?! Are you serious?

Sure. The soap we keep in the
hold for baths.

Ｉ can't believe we won
with soapy water!

Ｉt used to be a proper battle tactic.
Look, it's right here in this book.

'Wait for the soapy water to slow the
enemy crew, then board.' See?

Ｉtalian galleys used to carry soap as a
weapon, you know.

Ｉt was a common trick in Europe back
when most sea battles were
fought by boarding.
Sounds like a tall tale to me...

When did you have time to get all this
ready, Julian?

A little at a time, whenever Ｉ had a
free moment.

Ｉ could hardly believe it when Ｉ read
about it either.

Ｉ wanted to try it just once. Ｉ didn't
expect it to work quite that well.

You'd have to be a real fool to fall for
that twice.

No luck, huh? Maybe Ｉ was asking a
little much of a bit of soapy water.

Damn, Ｉ've lost again. But next time
Ｉ'll... Huh?!

Sorry, Captain. There won't be a next
time for you.
Heh heh heh.
What did you say? Say that again!
What, didn't you hear me?

There's nobody left on this ship who'll
do as you say!
Damn you! You've turned on me!
Hm?

Looks like there's trouble aboard that
pirate's ship.
What's going on? Bring us closer!

Ｉt's been one defeat after another, and
we haven't made a coin. You'll answer
for that.
Answer for it...?

Why are you chasing FO all
over the place, anyway?

Heh! You've got a reason you can't
tell the rest of us, haven't you?

You just want the Bloodstained
Shamshir back from FO. Ｉt
belonged to your father, didn't it?
That's... No, Ｉ didn't mean to...

You've let us down. Who'd follow a
captain who can't earn a coin? Say
your prayers!

They're going to kill her if we just
stand here!
Leave it to me.
What's this? Stay out of it, stranger!

An underling like you ought to know
his place.

None of your business! Lads, get rid of
him and Aziza both!
Al, allow me to stand with you.
Ｉ'll lend a hand too!

Ｉf ever there was a time to draw a
sword, this is it.

Count me in! Men who need a whole
gang to fight are the worst!
Tch. You're making work for us!

Woo-hoo! You'll have me to
deal with too!
Come on, pirates! Ｉ'll take you on!

Why...? Why are you fighting for me?
A moment ago we were enemies.
D-damn it, we're outmatched!

Looks like we've traded places since we
met in that tavern.
FI FA...
...You want something from her too?

Ｉ do. Let's settle this by
talking it over.

You can't win this. What other choice
have you got?
Damn it. All right, Ｉ'll hear you out.

You have no intention of serving under
her anymore, do you?

Of course not. Nobody on this ship
wants to be a pirate for nothing.

Then it's simple. Come aboard
our ship instead.

What?! You expect us to
work for you?!

Don't be ridiculous. Ｉ was asking Aziza
to come with us.

Ｆine by me. But she's put us through
hell. We'll want paying for the trouble.
You want money?!
...How much?
A million gold will settle it.

Then you've nothing left to complain
about. Come with us, Aziza.
But...
Nothing left for us here. Ｆarewell!

My own crew turned on me. Ｉ've fallen
a long way. Anyway, why did
you save me?

You think we could just
leave you there?

Why are you a pirate at all? With your
skill, you could earn a
good living honestly.

...My father was a pirate. Ｉ grew up a
pirate's daughter.

Those were my father's men. Ｉ grew up
watching them and learned both the
sword and piracy from them.
Where is your father now?

He died in an accident. That sword was
his. Ｉt disappeared with him.

And that sword was
the Bloodstained Shamshir...

So that's what you meant when you
said Ｉ had a fine sword.

Ｉ wanted to be a great pirate like my
father. Ｉ copied everything he did.

So when Ｉ learned you had the sword, Ｉ
had to have it back. Ｉ thought
if Ｉ did...

Ｉt'd prove Ｉ was a little more like him.
Heh. But then...

Ｉ'd told myself Ｉ wanted to be a great
pirate. All Ｉ really wanted was
something to remember him by.

No wonder they walked out on me. The
thing Ｉ was chasing wouldn't earn them
a coin.
...Still want to be a pirate?

All this time, Ｉ was just trying to
follow my father. Ｉ'm done with piracy.

Then why not come with us? A life at
sea suits you better than dry land.

You'd take me with you?
Are you sure?

Of course. You'd be a fearsome enemy,
and Ｉ'd be glad to have you
at my side.

Thank you. Ｉ'll give it everything Ｉ
have. Ｉ owe you my life, after all.

We're even, then. You let us go back
at the tavern.
And you can just call me Aziza.
Welcome aboard, Aziza!

Ｉ'm pulling back for today! Next time,
Ｉ'll finish this!
Ｉ've had quite enough, thanks...

Ｉ'll pull back for now, but Ｉ'll never
yield! Remember my name.
Ｉ'm Aziza Nurennahar!
She doesn't give up easily, does she?

We've lost this one. Let's pull
back for now!

Well, Admiral? Think twice before you
look down on pirates again!

Ｉ did underestimate you. Ｉt won't go
this way next time.

Ha! Come back and Ｉ'll
beat you again!

Ｉt's no use! We're no match for her.
Pull back!
What? You're running away?

So there! Sometimes getting away is
the victory!

You really thought you could beat me?
Next time we meet, you'd
better be ready!
That's Espinosa's fleet!
Espinosa?
He's notorious for trading in slaves.
W-wait, FI! What are you doing?
Are you Espinosa, the slave trader?
Hm? What a rude young lady.
There's no point trying to hide it.

Me? A slave trader? Ha ha ha! What
an accusation.
So you're going to play innocent?

Listen here. Ｉ have better things to do
than hear your baseless accusations.

Even if it were true, what business is
it of yours? Go back to your own
country before you get hurt.

So that's your answer? You buy and
sell people. Ｉ'll never stand for that.

You brats don't know when to stop. Do
you really want to make me angry?
You'll pay for it.

You won't frighten me
into backing down.

You mean to cross me? Plenty of
others have tried. Ｆor some reason,
none of them lived very long.

The sea can be a dangerous place. Do
take care.
Ｉ've had enough of this. Let's go!
Aye, aye.

FI! You were the one who told me
not to start trouble!
Ｉ couldn't let that pass.

Of course not! Ｉf you hadn't told me
to hold back, Ｉ'd have said the same
thing myself.
...We'll be all right.
Huh?

The Church in Rome forbids slave
trading. Portugal can hardly object if
we go after a slaver.

Ｉ see. Then we can take the
fight to him!
Espinosa... You'd better be ready.
FI... So it's come to this at last.
...Get out of my sight. Now!
Hurry! Before Lord Escante finds out!
Juan...
All ships, to battle stations!
Juan!

FI... Ｉf this is what you've chosen,
there's nothing Ｉ can do.

Ｉ swore Ｉ'd fight you with all Ｉ had.
Maybe Ｉ was making a promise to
myself to let you go.

Ｉ'm setting my heart aside. You must
do the same. Neither of us
can show mercy.
FI!
Ryoke...!

Leave the past behind you! Don't look
at him!
FI, look ahead!

Our people are suffering! Our ways and
traditions may be wiped out! Remember
all they're asking of us!
Look ahead...
Don't just stand there! Let's go!
Truvin! Your crimes end here!

Do you really mean to take me on?
Siding with the Hanseatic League will
get you nowhere.
Ｉ'm not weighing what Ｉ stand to gain!

Are you mad? Do you think you can
beat us? Every country sends ships out
to raid.

Attacking foreign merchantmen at will
is an open challenge to our
pirate-hunting fleet.

Stubborn as ever. Very well, you can
die for it!
FI! What do we do?
Aid Gerhard's fleet
Withdraw
Understood!
Hm? Who's that?!

FO?! Damn you! You've
brought company!

Leave those paupers for later! Take out
the newcomers first!
Well? How did it go?

Very well, sir. Every governor we
brought round seems to be refusing
FO entry.

The king of Ternate is as stubborn as
ever, though...

Ｉf he won't listen, send some of the
lads round. Once they stir up a little
trouble, he'll quiet down.
As you wish, sir.
Aaaah!

Ｉt looks like pirates are attacking a
merchant ship!

Pirates are attacking
that merchant ship!

Look! Pirates are attacking
a merchant ship!

Looks like pirates are attacking that
merchant ship!

That merchant ship's under
attack by pirates!

Look! A merchant ship! Pirates are
attacking it!

Admiral, a merchant ship is under
attack by pirates!

All hands, battle stations! Ｆire a
warning shot and see what they do!
Aye-aye!
Aye!
A-aah!

Admiral! Looks like that warning sent
the pirates running!

Admiral! We gave them a little fright,
and it looks as if they're fleeing!

Admiral! We just scared them a little
and they ran away!

Admiral! All it took was a warning.
The pirates are off!

Admiral! We barely scared them and
they took off!

Admiral! A bit of a fright, and it
seems they've fled!

Admiral! We hardly scared them, and
off they went!

Admiral! Ｉt seems a small fright was
all it took to send the pirates away!
Well, that was a letdown.

Ｉ'm glad they weren't much of a
threat. Let's check on
the merchant ship.
How is it?

A few minor injuries, it seems. The
cargo's the main loss.

They got away fast, but they still made
off with the lot.

Oh, excuse me! Are you the admiral?
Ｉ'm the captain of this merchant ship!

Looks like they've taken every bit of
your cargo.

Oh, never mind the cargo! What's a
cargo to a life? Thank you ever so
much for saving mine!

What do we do about the ship? Looks
like she's taken quite a beating.

Most of our crew jumped overboard and
fled to the other ships. We can't move
an inch!
Other ships? Ｉ don't see any.

Some disappeared. The others went over
to the pirates...

So they left you behind. Nothing for it,
then. We'll have to leave
this ship here.
No! You can't!
What...?

Ｉ put my heart and soul into fitting
out my beloved Elysion. Please, don't
leave her behind!

Ｉ see how much she means to you. All
right. We'll tow her to
Alexandria for now.
Admiral! Look at that ship!

Admiral! There's a funny-looking ship
out there!
Admiral! Look at that strange ship!
Admiral! Get a look at that odd ship!
Admiral! Ｉ've spotted a strange ship!

Admiral! There's a weird
ship over there!
Admiral! Strange ship sighted!

Admiral, Ｉ can see a
rather strange ship!
W-what's that?!
Aah! A g-ghost ship!

Ah, FI. Admiral Blanco
is expecting you.

Admiral Blanco is Lord Escante's chief
adviser now. Things aren't the way
they used to be. Keep that in mind.
Ｉ know that already.
There you are.
Juan...

You finished first in your class every
term, right through graduation.
Congratulations.

Professor Hernandez was amazed. He
said no one had ever done it before.
Thank you.

Keep this up and they may make an
exception and let you move to Spain,
just as you wanted.
Really?

Ｆirst, Ｉ have a job for someone with
your talents. We'll talk about Spain
after that.
A job? What do you mean?
FI, Ｉ want you to command a fleet.
A fleet? Me?

Ｉ know this is sudden. There's no time
to explain it all, so Ｉ'll keep it brief.

Lord Escante's forces are working every
day to build a new nation here under a
new order.

But someone's been challenging us
lately, and he isn't shy about showing
how ruthless he can be.
Vasquez de Maldonado...
Yes.

Ｉ thought he was an upstart nobody
knew anything about. He gained power
so fast we can't ignore him anymore.

As you know, the pirates on his payroll
have hit our merchant fleet hard.

He's also forcing local people to work
for next to nothing and making a
fortune off them.

Lord Escante is furious. Acting
governor of Cuba or not, Maldonado
can't be allowed to carry on like this.
Are you going to war?

We're defending our merchant ships
from pirates, that's all. But that's not
your job.
Hm?

My fleet will fight the pirates. You'll
use trade to cut
off Maldonado's income.

So Ｉ come at him from the side. You
want me to take over his markets?
Exactly. You catch on quickly.

You know how trade works around here.
That's why Ｉ told Lord Escante you
were the right person for the job.

You'll get funds to spend as you see
fit. Lord Escante will take a share of
the profits.
One more thing...
Yes?

This is important. Until Maldonado is
defeated, sign every trade contract in
your own name.
Ah. Now Ｉ see what this is about.
Hm?

Ｉf Lord Escante went after Maldonado's
markets himself, they'd end up fighting
each other.

So you set up a third faction on paper
and make it the one
Maldonado goes after...
Enough!

Think what you like. Ｉ didn't call you
in for your opinion. This is an order.
Anyway...

Once Maldonado is defeated, all the
Shares in your name will pass
to Lord Escante.
Ｆine by me. Ｉ don't care about that.
Ｉf that's all, Ｉ'm leaving.
Wait, FI.
Yes?

Ｉf we gain control of the New World,
Lord Escante will be as powerful as
Valdes. More powerful, even.

His forces could replace Valdes's as
Spain's regular army. And
then you could...
Juan...
FI! Over here!
Samwell! You came to meet me?
Of course Ｉ did!
So, what did he want?

Well... they want me to
command a fleet.
Really?! That's amazing!

Does that mean you don't have to work
for that guy anymore?
That guy... You mean Juan?
Yeah! Ｉ can't stand him!
Well... Ｉ suppose so.

Anyway, let's go home. Ｉ'm starving,
and Ｉ could really go for some of your
cooking, Samwell.

Leave it to me! Ｉ'll make something
extra good to celebrate!
Ｉ can't wait.
FI, your hair's really pretty.
Really? Ｉ don't like it.
Why not?

Because of this hair, Ｉ...
Oh, never mind.

Really? Ｉ love it. Ｉt looks like my
mom's hair.
Your mom's hair?

Yeah! ... Ｉ don't remember her very
well anymore, though.

Thanks, Samwell. Ｉ think Ｉ like my hair
a little better now.
Ｉt's you...!

Ｉ've heard how well you're doing. The
Spaniards must think highly of you to
give you a fleet.

Ｉ hear you outwitted Maldonado. No
wonder the Spaniards trusted you with
a fleet.
W-what do you want?

Ｉ've been thinking since we last met.
Can Ｉ really just leave you to this?

Leave me to what? What are you
talking about?

You carry the blood of Tawantinsuyu.
You're the only hope we have left. You
have to know the truth.

Hope? How convenient. You've lost
your allies, so now you want to drag
me into your rebellion?
One day, that's where you'll end up.

Ｉt's my life. You don't get to decide it
for me.
Deny it all you like. Ｉt's your fate.
Don't tell me what my fate is.

FI, do you really know what
Escante's men are like?

...Are you going to speak ill
of him again?

Him? Escante's right hand, you mean.
You're rather taken with
him, aren't you?
What has this Juan been telling you?

That they're going to build a new
nation under a new order...

Ha! Just the sort of scheme Ｉ'd expect
from the Spaniards.

They'll use you as heir to the throne,
so it looks like our country
is coming back.

They'll sweet-talk us into going along.
Then this continent will be theirs in
name and in fact.

N-no. Juan... Ｉ mean,
Lord Escante wouldn't...

Have you ever stopped to think about
who's doing the fighting?
We are. Our own people.

The Spaniards set their allies on any
people who resist, then give those same
allies the power.

We used to stand as equals. Now they
make us rivals and dangle power in
front of us to keep us in line.

They sit back and stay clear of blame
while people with no quarrel spill each
other's blood!
...You're lying.

Think Ｉ'm lying if you like. Ｉt's up to
you who you believe.
That can't be...

FI, you've felt it too, haven't you?
Something's wrong.

Ｉf you won't believe me, Ｉ'll
do it alone.

Ｉ'd sooner die fighting than spend my
life taking their orders!
Ryoke...

Ｉ won't come back. Good luck making
that man happy. Goodbye.
...Wait!

Ｉ knew. Yes... Ｉ knew
something wasn't right.

Ｉ shut my eyes and covered my ears. Ｉ
thought Ｉ could forget it all if Ｉ got
off this continent.

But Ｉ know leaving won't free me from
what's been weighing on my heart.
Then what's holding you back?

Ｉ've always been alone. Among my own
people, and after the Spaniards took
me in.

Ｉf Ｉ turn my back on who Ｉ am now,
Ｉ'll lose everything! Ｉ can't take that
step alone.

Can you honestly say you
aren't alone now?

Ｉt's an illusion. Crossing the sea won't
change a thing. Those people aren't
the ones who stand with you!
The ones who stand with me...

'Your duty, your place and your people
are here, on the land where the Sun
God shines.'

Before he died, the elder used to say
that whenever he worried about you.
He worried about me?
He did.

Ryoke... What do you want me to do?
What can Ｉ do?

You'll find that out as you go.
Nothing's going to happen until you
take the first step!

Good. You're starting to come
to your senses.

Ｉ don't see that doubt in
your eyes anymore.

Ｉ've just had an idea. FI, Ｉ'm joining
your crew.
What?!

Your ship's good cover. You may not
be a comrade yet, but Ｉ can see you're
on our side. That's a relief.
Ryoke! Wait a minute!

Ｉ've made up my mind. Ｉ'm staying
aboard until you join our cause.

Go on, give me an order. Ｉ've never
worked aboard a ship, but
Ｉ'll learn fast!
FI. We need to talk.
What's the matter?

Hear me out. Hold off
on finishing Maldonado.
What? Why?

Everything FO controls now
goes to Escante once Maldonado falls,
doesn't it?

There's nothing Ｉ can do about it.
That was the agreement.

Don't give up yet. Escante and
Maldonado are keeping each other in
check. Neither can move.

Use the time to secure bases and trade
routes outside the New World, where
neither of them is watching.

Outside the New World? You mean
building territory of our own in Africa
or Asia?

Escante can take every Share we have
here when Maldonado falls. With a port
elsewhere, we can still break away.
Ｉndependent...!
Ｉ never saw it until Ｉ met you.

Ｉ used to think the only answer to
conquest was fighting back. Ｉt takes
more than that.

With your talent, we can grow strong
enough to stand against them before
they even notice.

Me? You really think Ｉ can stand
up to Escante?
You can! No one else can do it, FI.
No one else...

Ｉt's the same here in Africa as it is
back home. The Portuguese rule the
people who were here first by force.

Some crooked merchants make a
fortune selling people into slavery.
That's horrible...

Let's drive them out and win over the
townspeople. We can ask them to trade
with FO.
Who might you people be?
Hm?

You amateurs can barely sail, and now
you're playing at trade? Keep out of
my waters.
What did you say?

West Africa is Portugal's territory.
Your fleet is Spanish. Go trade in the
New World.
We're... We're no Spaniards.

What are you talking about? Your
people come from land that belongs to
Spain now, don't they?

You decided that for yourselves. You
carve up the world to suit you and call
it yours. How arrogant.

What a troublesome lot. Ｉf you mean to
encroach on my territory, Ｉ'll have to
take measures.
Oh yeah? What do you plan to do?

Ｉmpertinent brat. You'll be singing a
different tune soon enough.

'Sing a different tune,' will we? What
a vile man. He'll be the one singing it.
Let's run that bastard out of here!

Ｉ'd like to. We have to think before we
start a fight.

FI! We won't get anywhere if we lose
our nerve now.

Ｉ hate to admit it, but what he said is
what the Europeans take for granted.

As far as they're concerned, Africa
belongs to Portugal and we're subjects
of Spain.

Ｉf Spain and Portugal make this a
quarrel between them, every fleet under
either flag could turn against us.
So what do we do?

We're building a base so we can break
away from Escante. That's still the
plan, isn't it?
W-well, yes.

There's no need to fight the great
powers of Europe just yet.

We'll build up our Share
quietly and steadily.

We can make our move once we're
strong enough.
What's wrong?
